story_log.title: Brewers beat Rays 3-2 in World Series Game 1 — wild 9th inning, overturned double play, first WS win since 1982
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 18, TIER 1 WORLD SERIES GAME 1]: Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 3-2 per ground truth. Wild 9th inning: Rays loaded bases, game-ending double play overturned on replay review, Trevor Megill closed it out per JeffPassan/ESPN. Milwaukee's first World Series win in 44 years (last: 1982) per TalkinBaseball. Jacob Misiorowski: 5.0 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, set postseason record with 103.5 MPH pitch per ESPN/TalkinBaseball. William Contreras threw out runners in back-to-back innings per TalkinBaseball. Rays aggressive baserunning backfired twice — Victor Mesa Jr. caught stealing third to end threat per TalkinBaseball. Chourio RBI single in 7th made it 3-1 per ground truth. Series: MIL 1-0, Game 2 Saturday.

Warriors led 106-94 with 3:47 left per ground truth. Cam Boozer: 25 PTS, 13 REB, 6 AST per StatMuse — go-ahead basket with 0:20.1 left per ground truth. Ty Jerome: 28 PTS (8 first half, 20 second half) per ground truth — averaging 36.5 PPG to start season per StatMuse. Memphis's first win at Golden State since 2021-10-28 per ground truth. Steph Curry: 'There's losses and then there's ways that you lose like tonight that kind of sting a little bit more' per ClutchPoints. Warriors imploded down stretch per ESPN.

lead_story.topic: Brewers beat Rays 3-2 in World Series Game 1
lead_story.headline: Brewers survive wild 9th to take World Series Game 1 3-2 — overturned double play, first WS win in 44 years

tweets.text: FINAL: Brewers 3, Rays 2 Milwaukee wins Game 1 of the World Series following a wild ninth inning in which Tampa Bay loaded the bases, a game-ending double play was overturned on replay review and Trevor Megill closed it out. Hell of a first game. These are two very good teams.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 18]: Reader knows this is first WS between two teams that have never won, Milwaukee swept Dodgers, Rays beat Guardians. Today's new development is Game 1 itself. Skip the backstory, lead with the wild 9th inning. Milwaukee's first World Series win since 1982 — 44 years. Only 5 franchises have longer active droughts without a WS *win* (not appearance): Mariners (never), Padres (never), Brewers (1982), Rangers (never won one despite 2 appearances), Rockies (never). Misiorowski's 103.5 MPH pitch is fastest postseason pitch ever tracked (since 2008). Contreras throwing out runners in back-to-back innings — catcher defense as X-factor. Rays' baserunning aggression backfired twice (Mesa caught stealing third, earlier miscue). Game-ending double play overturned on replay — Brewers fans went from euphoria to terror back to euphoria in 60 seconds. Trevor Megill closed it out after replay scare. Compare this to other famous WS Game 1 nail-biters: 2001 (Diamondbacks-Yankees 9-1), 2016 (Cubs-Indians 1-0), 2019 (Nationals-Astros 5-4). First time in 100+ years two teams with no titles meet — last was Phillies-Royals 1980. GIF seed: smug relief after the replay overturn validated — Brewers fans exhaling after scare. Meme seed: Brewers celebrating, then panicking during replay, then celebrating again (panik-kalm-panik). William Contreras and Jacob Misiorowski as Brewers heroes — young stars delivering. Rays' aggressiveness is 'who we are' per ESPN — they won't change approach despite two costly mistakes.
lead_story.gif_concept: Weary relief when a long wait ends, exhale after a scare — Brewers fans after the replay confirmed the out and they survived
lead_story.meme_concept: Worry (game-ending DP), GENUINE relief (out call), then worse worry (replay review might overturn it)
